prompt: Why does the man not want to measure across the doorway during class?
promptZh: 男子為什麼不想在上課期間橫跨門口量測？
explanationZh: 男子不想在有人使用門口時把捲尺拉過去。

options.text: The floor mat will already be installed.
options.whyZh: 還沒訂地墊；需要先量測。

options.text: People will still be passing through the doorway.
options.whyZh: 男子不想在有人使用門口時把捲尺拉過去。

options.text: The classroom is on another floor.
The tape measure will be borrowed by the caretaker.
options.whyZh: 管理員負責關門，不是借捲尺。

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: I can come then, but I won’t stretch a tape across the doorway while people are using it. I could take a photo of the frame from the hall.
